type: ∀ {r : ℕ} {v : Fin (r + 1 + 1)} (π : BHRSY.Ordering (r + 1 + 1) v) {M : Finset ℕ}, M ⊆ Finset.Icc 2 (r + 1) → BHRSY.parallelepiped v π M = zonotope (Pi.single (π.pos (BHRSY.lastMarked M)) 1) (Finset.Icc 2 (r + 1)) (fun i => Pi.single (π.pos (BHRSY.markedParent M i)) 1 - Pi.single (π.pos i) 1)

∀ {r : ℕ} {v : Fin (r + 1 + 1)} (π : BHRSY.Ordering (r + 1 + 1) v) {M : Finset ℕ}, M ⊆ Finset.Icc 2 (r + 1) → ∀ (hne : M.Nonempty), BHRSY.parallelepiped v π M = zonotope (Pi.single (π.pos (M.max' hne)) 1) (Finset.Icc 2 (r + 1)) (fun i => Pi.single (π.pos (BHRSY.markedParent M i)) 1 - Pi.single (π.pos i) 1)

∀ {r : ℕ} {v : Fin (r + 1 + 1)} (π : BHRSY.Ordering (r + 1 + 1) v), BHRSY.parallelepiped v π ∅ = zonotope (Pi.single (π.pos 1) 1) (Finset.Icc 2 (r + 1)) (fun i => Pi.single (π.pos 1) 1 - Pi.single (π.pos i) 1)

∀ {r : ℕ} {v : Fin (r + 1 + 1)} (π : BHRSY.Ordering (r + 1 + 1) v) {M : Finset ℕ}, M ⊆ Finset.Icc 2 (r + 1) → ∀ (y : Point (r + 1 + 1)), BHRSY.paramidSupport v π M y = y v + MaxCaterpillar.relu (y (π.pos (BHRSY.lastMarked M)) - y v + ∑ i in Finset.Icc 2 (r + 1), MaxCaterpillar.relu (y (π.pos (BHRSY.markedParent M i)) - y (π.pos i)))

∀ {r : ℕ} {v : Fin (r + 1 + 1)} (π : BHRSY.Ordering (r + 1 + 1) v) {M : Finset ℕ}, M ⊆ Finset.Icc 2 (r + 1) → (BHRSY.cutSet (r := r) M).card = M.card ∧ ∀ y : Point (r + 1 + 1), BHRSY.paramidSupport v π M y = y v + caterpillarFunction (caterpillarWordDescription π.word (BHRSY.cutSet M)) y

∀ {r : ℕ} {v : Fin (r + 1 + 1)} (π : BHRSY.Ordering (r + 1 + 1) v) {M : Finset ℕ}, M ⊆ Finset.Icc 2 (r + 1) → M.Nonempty → ∃ k ∈ caterpillarDescriptions r, ∀ y, BHRSY.paramidSupport v π M y = y v + caterpillarFunction k y

∀ {r : ℕ} (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (r + 1 + 1))) {S : Finset (Fin (r + 1))}, S.Nonempty → (0 : Fin (r + 1)) ∉ S → ∃ (v : Fin (r + 1 + 1)) (π : BHRSY.Ordering (r + 1 + 1) v) (M : Finset ℕ), M ⊆ Finset.Icc 2 (r + 1) ∧ M.Nonempty ∧ ∀ y, BHRSY.paramidSupport v π M y = y v + caterpillarFunction (caterpillarWordDescription σ S) y
∀ {r : ℕ} {v : Fin (r + 1 + 1)} (π : BHRSY.Ordering (r + 1 + 1) v) (y : Point (r + 1 + 1)), BHRSY.paramidSupport v π ∅ y = y v + Trees.rootedStar v (π.pos 1) y
∀ {r : ℕ} {a c : Fin (r + 1 + 1)}, a ≠ c → ∀ {k : FaceKey r}, k ∈ caterpillarDescriptions r → Trees.rootedStar a c ≠ caterpillarFunction k
∀ {r : ℕ} {v : Fin (r + 1 + 1)} (π : BHRSY.Ordering (r + 1 + 1) v), ¬ ∃ k ∈ caterpillarDescriptions r, ∀ y, BHRSY.paramidSupport v π ∅ y = y v + caterpillarFunction k y

∀ {r : ℕ} {v : Fin (r + 1 + 1)} (π : BHRSY.Ordering (r + 1 + 1) v) {M : Finset ℕ}, M ⊆ Finset.Icc 2 (r + 1) → (M.Nonempty ∧ ∃ k ∈ caterpillarDescriptions r, ∀ y, BHRSY.paramidSupport v π M y = y v + caterpillarFunction k y) ∨ (M = ∅ ∧ (∀ y, BHRSY.paramidSupport v π M y = y v + Trees.rootedStar v (π.pos 1) y) ∧ ¬ ∃ k ∈ caterpillarDescriptions r, ∀ y, BHRSY.paramidSupport v π M y = y v + caterpillarFunction k y)
